ccby_rights_clean_anchor.significance: A genuinely rights-clean (CC-BY) IN-SCOPE DGEBA + cycloaliphatic-amine cure-kinetics dataset EXISTS in the open literature. The prior 'wall' finding (rights_clean n in-scope = 0) was scoped to the 26 IN-TREE datasets; it does not hold for the open literature. The cure-potlife unblock is therefore a bounded ACQUISITION+rights-review task, not an impossibility -- though this Ea dataset is cure-kinetics, not the gel-time/pot-life quantity the KPI ultimately needs.
ccby_rights_clean_anchor.source: PMC6473346 (Polymers, MDPI, CC-BY), full text fetched this run

ccby_cycloaliphatic_bracket_rate.interpretation: model cycloaliphatic Ea inside the directly-fetched CC-BY IPDA envelope

family_reactivity_ordering.interpretation: cycloaliphatic apparent Ea <= aromatic apparent Ea (expected from amine nucleophilicity)

honest_limitations: Corroboration is of physical PLAUSIBILITY (Ea magnitude + family ordering), not absolute pot-life accuracy.
Only 3/10 literature records are directly-fetched CC-BY (the IPDA anchor); the rest are recorded from published abstracts/search returns and labelled SUPPORTING, lower-confidence.
Peak-exotherm Kissinger Ea (e.g. TETA 76.8) exceeds the model's apparent pot-life Ea -- consistent physics, but it means the union envelope is intentionally wide.
The rights-clean CC-BY anchor is cure-KINETICS (Ea), not the gel-time/pot-life quantity the Phase-0 KPI scores; it corroborates the temperature-scaling physics, not the pot-life labels.

independent_literature.note: peak-exotherm (whole-reaction) Ea; expected to exceed the gel/pot-life apparent Ea
independent_literature.source: DGEBA/TETA non-isothermal DSC, Mater. Sci. Forum 514-516, 1094

question: Are amphora-cure-potlife-gate's per-family apparent activation energies corroborated by DGEBA-amine cure Ea published in the open, rights-separate literature (including a directly-fetched CC-BY open-access dataset)?
theory: Arrhenius (1889) rate-constant temperature scaling; amine-family reactivity ordering from nucleophilicity/sterics of the N-H addition to the oxirane (aliphatic primary amine fastest -> lowest Ea; aromatic diamine slowest -> highest Ea). Peak-exotherm Kissinger Ea (whole reaction) >= gel/pot-life apparent Ea at low conversion.

verdict.near_miss_note: 1/12 model systems (dgeba-mannich, 48.0 kJ/mol) falls 0.64 kJ/mol below the independent literature min (48.64) -- within rounding on the fastest-reacting (Mannich/phenalkamine) family, where open literature is sparse. Reported honestly, not tuned away.
verdict.statement: The cure-potlife Arrhenius model's per-family apparent activation energies are 11/12 contained within the independent open-literature envelope (the one miss is a 0.64 kJ/mol under-shoot on the Mannich system), are tightly bracketed for the cycloaliphatic family by a directly-fetched CC-BY dataset, and preserve the expected amine-family reactivity ordering. This independently CORROBORATES the model's physics on data outside its parameterisation lineage. It does NOT promote the module and does NOT satisfy the Phase-0 rights gate.
